name: cloudpass-desktop
description: Build-time tooling for the CloudPass desktop and Android clients.
//: This file exists for one reason: the Android build does not start without it.
The Rust plugin inside desktop/gen/android runs `npm run -- tauri android
android-studio-script`, and npm refuses to run a script that no package.json
declares. The desktop build never noticed, because scripts/build-desktop.ps1
calls the Tauri CLI through npx directly.
The CLI is a dev dependency rather than another npx call because Gradle is the
caller here: it resolves `tauri` through node_modules, and a version pinned in
one place is the version both builds use.
